description: A vestal config file. Every key is optional: the file is merged over the built-in defaults.

defaultView.description: The view show and toggle open.

functions.description: jq functions with no arguments, name → body, callable from every expression. Names match ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$ and may not shadow a builtin.

gesture.description: Trackpad gesture for the dashboard: pinch (thumb and three fingers, the old Launchpad gesture). Pinching in opens it, spreading closes it, and the fade follows the fingers. macOS only; ignored on Linux. null registers nothing.

hotkey.description: Built-in toggle hotkey: f1-f20, letters, digits, space, escape, home or end, with cmd (super), ctrl, alt (opt) and shift, joined with +. Letters, digits, space and escape need cmd, ctrl or alt. null registers nothing; bind `vestal toggle` in the window manager instead.

keys.description: Global key bindings: a key (h, 2, tab, shift+tab, cmd+r, ...) → an action or a list of actions. escape and alt+i are reserved.

pages.description: Paging between views, like home screens: their order, the transition, the dots and the swipe. left and right (and tab) page when the keys are unbound.

platform.description: Per-OS overrides: a macos and a linux block, each merged over the rest of the file on that OS only.

secrets.description: Named secrets, usable in source definitions as {{ $secrets.name }}. Never write a secret's value into the config.

sources.description: Named data sources. Widgets refer to them by name; every widget reading one shares its fetch. null deletes a built-in one.

templates.description: Parameterized widgets and sources, used like a type. Built-in templates (the presets) are separate; a user template with a built-in's name needs "override": true.

views.description: Named views. The dashboard shows main.

widgets.description: Named widgets. A widget shows when a view's order lists its key. null deletes a built-in one.
